messages:
alex_k: FYI — planned deploy tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. This is a model routing + kv-cache config change (no schema migrations). Handoff notes below, please read if you're oncall or watching.

alex_k: Freeze window: 08:30-10:00 UTC. No non-emergency infra changes during freeze. Canaries start at 09:00. Full shift targeted by 09:30 if healthy.

maria: tagging visibility — what's the rollback plan if latency regresses? @jordan

jordan: rollback plan: immediate route back to model v1 (traffic switch) + disable kv-cache flag. Command quick refs in case oncall needs to run:
```
# switch traffic back to v1
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/route -d '{"target":"v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
# disable cache
kubectl patch cm model-config -p '{"data":{"kv_cache":"false"}}'
```
We also have automated health-check monitor that will auto-failover at 3 consecutive 5xxs in 2m.

lee: Expected risk: low->medium. The change is config-only but we've seen a 50-100ms tail in staging when cache rehydration happens. Watchers should keep an eye on p50/p95 latency, and ops.error-rate.

samira: I'll be the primary rollout watcher 08:45-10:15 UTC. Will monitor traces and can run rollback if needed. @alex_k I'll own the initial canary checks.

alex_k: thanks @samira. Can someone cover 10:15-12:00 if the post-rollout soak needs follow-up? I have a calendar conflict.

maria: I can cover 10:15-11:30.

jordan: I can be backup 11:30-12:30. If anything pops after 12:30, tag oncall rotation.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex_k for 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (15m intervals). Healthchecks enabled.

lee: Quick FYI — DB is read-only for a short window for the migration we ran last week; this deploy touches cache only but we should avoid heavy indexing tasks during the freeze.

samira: noted. I'll add a Don’t-Run note to #eng-sre and ping infra-runbook channel.

alex_k: Handoff checklist (very short):
- Confirm watchers listed: @samira (primary), @maria (10:15-11:30), @jordan (backup)
- Keep rollback command handy (above)
- Monitor p50/p95, error-rate, and kv-cache miss-rate
- If auto-failover triggers, follow-up by opening a ticket and notify @oncall

maria: small ask — if you see tail latency spike >250ms at p95, escalate immediately. Don't wait for 3xx 5xx counts.

samira: will do. I'll post a quick status update in this thread at canary start and after full shift.

alex_k: thanks all. If anyone needs swap for watcher shifts lmk now. Otherwise I'll hand off to @samira at 08:45 UTC tomorrow morning.

jordan: good luck — will be on-call around then and available if needed :thumbsup:

samira: handing notes acknowledged. I'll add post-rollout checklist in here after 09:30.
